description_en: To share a console page or embed it into a third-party system without requiring a password, you can call the CreateTicket operation to generate a ticket. You can then use the ticket to create a password-free link
description_zh: 如果您需要将控制台页面免密分享给其他人或者嵌入到第三方系统，可以调用CreateTicket生成票据，然后拼接免密链接
name: CreateTicket

parameters.help_en: - The expiration time of the URL for the embedded page, in seconds. The value can range from 0 to 2,592,000 seconds (30 days). The default value is 86,400 seconds (one day)
parameters.help_zh: - 过期时间（秒），即内嵌页面URL链接过期时间，默认86400秒（一天），取值0~2592000秒（30天）
parameters.name: expiration_time

parameters.help_en:
- The expiration time of the access token, in seconds. This is the period during which a user can access the page APIs. The value can range from 0 to 86,400 seconds (one day). The default value is 86,400 seconds (one day).

- The effective expiration time of the access token is the minimum value of accessTokenExpirationTime and expirationTime.

- If you call the operation using a Security Token Service (STS) token, the effective expiration time of the access token is the minimum value of accessTokenExpirationTime, expirationTime, and the expiration time of the STS token
parameters.help_zh:
- 访问令牌过期时间（秒），即用户可以访问页面接口的过期时间，默认86400秒（一天），取值0~86400秒（一天）。
- 访问令牌过期时间是accessTokenExpirationTime、expirationTime的最小值。
- 若通过STS调用，访问令牌过期时间（即用户可以访问页面接口的时间）是accessTokenExpirationTime、expirationTime、STS过期时间的最小值
parameters.name: access_token_expiration_time
